objective: Avoid unnecessary native ad allocations when users fast-scroll away during the existing 400ms viewability settling window, lowering Android load without touching video playback.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub Main 1e4c0714849a347fa529fbca1cfabf3d5632290d retains a 400ms viewability settle callback that sets eligible true without remeasuring and 1200ms poll. Production Android native OOM/ANR stack not available; this is a grounded resource prevention fix, not a declared crash root-cause repair.
chosenApproach: Pure viewport geometry helper and final on-screen remeasurement after 400ms, with foreground and unmount generation guards. No changes to ad creation/player components.
selectionRationale: Prevents wasted off-screen ad requests after fast scroll using the existing delay; keeps aggressive ads for genuinely visible slots and existing video playback untouched.
alternativeApproaches: Disable native ads: rejected because BUKLOD depends on monetization.
Increase 400ms delay blindly: rejected because it does not guarantee final visibility and harms ad fill.
Remeasure on-screen state just before eligibility, without altering any video: selected.
